title: Nightly snapshot and off-host copy of FPVBuddy's data
goal: FPVBuddy's server data survives a lost disk as well as NERV's does
acceptance: The server takes a consistent nightly snapshot that passes an integrity check before it replaces the previous file, keeps the agreed number, and copies it off the host as F-016-T01 names; a failure is logged once with its reason and retried; specs on a temporary store cover snapshot, integrity failure and retention
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: snapshot and retention as NERV's src/snapshots.ts; the off-host copy depends on the host and carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
